ops.title: Invert the oracle: Python onto spawnllm-core via wasmtime (0.9.0)
ops.description: Approved plan (session plan file: we-should-keep-the-tingly-quokka.md): rust/spawnllm-core becomes the single source of truth; Python becomes a thin wasmtime host like Go's wazero host. S1 generator ports to rust/conformance-gen (core generates vectors; Python freshness test dies). S2 blob de-commit (forward-only git rm — NO history rewrite, user-confirmed: all blob commits are ancestors of immutable v0.8.0 tags) + build_wasm.sh dual-dest + CI blob job/artifacts + release-pypi pre-build input + release-go detached blob-carrying alias-tag commit. S3 spawnllm/_core wasmtime glue (lock-guarded singleton, trap→re-instantiate). S4 Python refactor onto plan/resolve/strict_schema/retry_decision/auth_probes/isolation/capabilities ops; openai+anthropic → dev-only cross-check; wasmtime>=46 runtime dep. S5 docs + supersede architecture note 2ad55473 (fix discipline becomes core-first) + update fd9d1a0. Public API and the spawn patch boundary (backends.base.capture_cli etc.) unchanged.

ops.text: Python builds argv/resolve/retry/schema/probe/isolation via core dispatch; hand-written duplicates deleted
conformance-gen (Rust) generates vectors; freshness is a cargo test; Python/Go/Rust all replay green
wasm blob is gitignored + untracked everywhere and built from source in dev, CI, and all release workflows
wheel+sdist carry the blob (py3-none-any); openai/anthropic absent from runtime deps
v0.9.0 tag ships PyPI + crates + go/v0.9.0 blob-carrying alias tag; go mod download and pip install both resolve
